images.caption: The Charles L. and Dorothy Manson House, located at 1224 Highland Park Blvd. in Wausau, Wisconsin, is the fourth Usonian home by Frank Lloyd Wright.

place.source_title: Charles L. and Dorothy Manson House

brief: Usonian house by Frank Lloyd Wright (1938-41) on a sloping lot: horizontal bands of red-stained board-and-batten and brick, flat roofs with thin deep overhangs stepping up to a tall two-storey brick and wood study tower, and a low brick retaining wall and gravel strip at the street.

facade.notes: the Manson House (Wausau, 1941): red brick and horizontal board under thin flat roofs at several levels, a two-storey brick block at the core, ribbons of windows, low brick terrace walls; on a slope in pines; a stone-lined drainage edge along the road

why.note: a Wright Usonian: low roofs, local materials, the house turned to its garden
